tweet_text:
Like, the process to get this fairly pedestrian perspective warp was:
- edit in NBP to overlay Escher staircases
- make a conformal transform tool to skew the perspective
- edit again in NBP to fix artefacts

references.name: Relativity by M. C. Escher
references.evidence: Gravity-defying multi-directional staircases serving as the scene background.

references.name: Confused Travolta
references.evidence: Cutout of Vincent Vega looking around in confusion on the central staircase.

references.name: AK-47 (Counter-Strike)
references.evidence: Pixelated first-person shooter weapon model in the bottom-right view.

references.name: Segment Anything Model
references.evidence: Bright green mask outlines and highlight contours around all onscreen entities.

references.name: Doritos
references.evidence: Floating snack bags ejected from the barrel of the weapon.

result.one_line: A surreal digital collage warping M.C. Escher's staircases with FPS HUD elements, memes, and object segmentation overlays.
